command: set +e; ADB=/opt/homebrew/bin/adb; echo '--- ADB VERSION ---'; "$ADB" version; echo '--- DEVICES BEFORE ---'; "$ADB" devices -l; echo '--- MDNS ---'; "$ADB" mdns services; echo '--- TRY LAST KNOWN WIFI ENDPOINT ---'; "$ADB" connect 192.168.0.100:46727; sleep 2; echo '--- DEVICES AFTER ---'; "$ADB" devices -l; echo '--- USB SERIAL CHECK ---'; "$ADB" -s RFCT70L7E8J get-state 2>&1; echo '--- WIFI SERIAL CHECK ---'; "$ADB" -s 192.168.0.100:46727 get-state 2>&1
